claims.claim_ar: استعمال «ثُمَّ» للترتيب والتراخي؛ فصل ووصل بين بدء الخلق وإعادته لتبيان تتابع قدرة الله على الخلق والإعادة.
claims.claim_en: Use of «ثُمَّ» to indicate sequence and succession (separation-and-connection) between beginning creation and its repetition, highlighting the ordered power of God to originate and then restore creation.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Marks chronological order and emphasizes divine agency in both originating and re‑creating, reinforcing the certainty of resurrection.
